subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Out of every hospital in Maine on Medicare's list, every kind counted.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor) have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua) has the most, 1,125. About 9.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did St. Mary's Regional Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua) has the most, 1,125. About 6.2 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua) have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Covenant Health Systems hospital reports more; St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor) is next at 941. About 7.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Covenant Health Systems's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: What percent of St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor)'s inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Covenant Health Systems hospital runs higher; St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua) is next at 63 percent. Traditional Medicare was 27 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 39 percent.

questions.q: What percent of St. Mary's Regional Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor) runs highest, 66 percent. Traditional Medicare was 14 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 32 percent.

questions.q: What percent of St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua)'s inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor) runs highest, 66 percent. Traditional Medicare was 37 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 26 percent.

questions.q: What percent of St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor)'s inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?

questions.q: What percent of St. Mary's Regional Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other Covenant Health Systems hospital runs higher; St. Joseph Hospital (Bangor) is next at 20 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 43 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua)'s inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Mary's Regional Medical Center runs highest, 43 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 7 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Covenant Health Systems's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Covenant Health Systems hospitals; St. Joseph Hospital (Nashua) ran longest, 5.1 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Covenant Health Systems run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: Maine 2 and New Hampshire 1. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: In how many states does Covenant Health Systems run a hospital, by the federal list?
questions.why: Maine and New Hampshire.

questions.q: How many Covenant Health Systems hospitals are in Maine, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 2 of the 36 hospitals in Maine on CMS's list.

questions.q: How many Covenant Health Systems hospitals are in New Hampshire, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 1 of the 28 hospitals in New Hampshire on CMS's list.

questions.q: What percent of the hospitals in Maine belong to Covenant Health Systems?
questions.why: 2 of 36. The next biggest system there, Northern Light Health, has 10.

questions.q: How many beds do Covenant Health Systems's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.why: That is 9 percent of their 399 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.why: About 34 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
